name: goblins
description: Plataforma de foros multi-comunidad con personalización avanzada

scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --parallel --filter @goblins/api --filter @goblins/web run dev
scripts.owner:create: pnpm --filter @goblins/api run build && pnpm --filter @goblins/api run owner:create
